why: The mirror image of `status-applied-only-on-the-session-push`, and the one that reproduces the historical defect: the projection is retained but nothing repaints until the surface next moves. That is precisely production's order -- `hud.setState('playing')` runs before the first status carrying stocks -- so the strip stays dark for a whole live match until an unrelated `setState` (a pause) happens to revive it, which is the bug `versusStocksVisible`'s own doc comment records. MEASURED on this branch by making the edit and running the scoped file: 8 of 35 cases fail, and the ordering case that catches it is the PRODUCTION-order one, which the sibling mutation above leaves green. Two mutations, two directions, one property.
